note: Dated Pokémon GO release corrections applied on top of catalog.v1.json. `forms` adds forms the generated catalog lacks (Normal and Shiny only). `entries` changes availability: the date it took effect, the Pokémon (dex for the default species, or formId), the categories, and the official link. status defaults to "released"; use "unreleased" or "ineligible" to correct a mistake. Newer entries win. See catalog/README.md.

entries.note: Toxel and Shiny Toxel hatch from 10 km Eggs during Into the Wild, the officially dated global debut. Tradeable and size/IV categories follow Normal; no Shadow or Purified debut is established.
Sinistea debuts in one-star raids and Collection Challenge encounters. Shiny is dated separately.
Polteageist is obtainable by evolving Sinistea with 50 Candy, explicitly described in the debut post.
Shiny Sinistea debuts during Halloween Part I in wild encounters and one-star raids.
Shiny Polteageist is obtainable by evolving debuting Shiny Sinistea; the official Just My Cup of Tea post establishes that evolution. See the L1 audit for both sources.
Maschiff debuts in Mega Squads, obtainable through GO Pass from September 8. Reproduces the existing reviewed correction with dated provenance.
Mabosstiff is obtainable by evolving Maschiff with 50 Candy, explicitly described in the debut post. Reproduces the existing reviewed correction.
Shiny Flamigo debuts in Mega Squads wild encounters. Reproduces the existing reviewed correction with dated provenance.
Shiny Applin debuts during Harvest Festival 2026 in wild encounters and near Mossy Lure Modules.
Shiny Flapple is obtainable by evolving debuting Shiny Applin. Sweet Discoveries 2025 officially establishes the Tart Apple evolution; see the L1 audit.
Shiny Appletun is obtainable by evolving debuting Shiny Applin. Sweet Discoveries 2025 officially establishes the Sweet Apple evolution; see the L1 audit.
Shiny Dipplin is obtainable by evolving debuting Shiny Applin. Harvest Festival 2025 officially establishes the Syrupy Apple evolution; see the L1 audit.
Shiny Hydrapple is obtainable by evolving Shiny Dipplin. Harvest Festival 2025 officially establishes the Candy and buddy-catch requirements; see the L1 audit.
Harvest Festival: Taken Over (October 2–5, 2026): "For the first time in Pokémon GO, you'll be able to hatch Shiny Shroodle." From Eggs; the post gives no distance.

Harvest Festival: Taken Over: Team GO Rocket has turned Sandygast into a Shadow Pokémon; defeat Grunts to save it. Purified follows the Shadow debut, as for every Shadow species in the catalog.

Shiny Grafaiai follows the dated Shiny Shroodle debut by evolution, using the same sourced-evolution rule as Shiny Polteageist and the Applin family. The official evolution (50 Shroodle Candy) is documented at https://pokemongo.com/news/fashion-week-taken-over-by-TGR. This is a supported evolution inference, not a direct Grafaiai announcement. Rechecked 2026-10-15.

Shadow Golisopod follows the dated Shadow Wimpod debut and its officially documented 400 Candy evolution at https://pokemongo.com/news/Pokemon-TCG-Crossover-Event. Purified follows the catalog's paired Shadow rule. This is a sourced evolution inference; the takeover post names Wimpod directly. Rechecked 2026-10-15.

Shadow Palossand follows the dated Shadow Sandygast debut and its officially documented 50 Candy evolution at https://pokemongo.com/news/water-festival-2023. Purified follows the catalog's paired Shadow rule. This is a sourced evolution inference; the takeover post names Sandygast directly. Rechecked 2026-10-15.

Shiny Gigantamax Cinderace debuted during Max Battle Day, October 3, 2026, 2:00-5:00 p.m. local time. The existing catalog already enables this category; this entry records its official debut date and provenance without changing availability. Rechecked 2026-10-15.

Bramblin debuts in Fall Marathon: Buddy Trek (October 13, 10:00 a.m. local), from GO Pass tasks, Incense and Field Research. No Shiny announced. Brambleghast is recorded in its own entry (#947), from community sources.

Brambleghast follows the dated Bramblin debut by evolution (50 Bramblin Candy; walk 20 km as buddy), as reported by the community references Leek Duck and Serebii. The official source above is the Bramblin base-species page; Niantic's page does not mention Brambleghast, so this is not an official Niantic announcement. Added on Cody's 2026-10-15 decision with community sources. Categories mirror Bramblin's; no Shiny. Rechecked 2026-10-15.
Minior debuts in the wild during the Orionids meteor shower (October 19–24, 5:00–11:59 p.m. local), in Meteor Form. No Shiny announced. Core colors are battle appearances, not separate catalog forms.
